summary: Neptune Insurance Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K on April 22, 2026, announcing a $100 million stock repurchase program approved by its Board on April 21, 2026. The program authorizes open-market or private repurchases of Class A common stock, funded by cash from operations or its revolving credit facility. No specific price per share, premium, or expiration date is given; repurchases will comply with Rule 10b-18 and may involve Rule 10b5-1 plans. The program can be suspended at any time. Watch for actual buyback execution pace and impact on share count.
